name: session-sidebar
description: A side pane for every session: the road so far, background tasks with live output and test counts, subagents, and agent messages

otherMachines.title: Other machines
otherMachines.description: ssh targets (user@host, or a Host from ~/.ssh/config) whose Claude sessions show under Other sessions too, separated by commas. Read-only: a short script sent as `sh -s` lists their road.md and for-you.md; nothing else is sent. Empty: this machine only.
